messages:
Maya: hi all, Maya here (platform eng) 3 first week! hitting a 403 when trying to flip a feature in Console: /admin/flags/payment-retry. who owns temporary prod access or a quick JIT flow?

Chris: welcome @Maya :wave: we lock down prod flag edits. what stage do you need it for? quick repro or rolling fix?

Maya: need to reproduce a customer bug in prod data (can't reproduce in staging). just a 1-2 hour window to toggle, test, and revert.

Ellie: @Maya we can do a short-lived elevation. security asks for ticket + approval reason. if it's urgent i can sponsor.

ops-bot: New escalation created: ESC-9921. Approver: Ellie. Requester: Maya. Link: https://console.redwood.ai/jit/ESC-9921

Raj: if the JIT is delayed, i can add you to ff-temp-admins for a 2h window manually. DM me org handle.

Maya: Ticket: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/PROD-2207. short reason: investigate payment retry off in prod causing checkout failures.

Ellie: approving now. note: system will trigger MFA step during approval. also please capture exact change and revert time in the ticket.

ops-bot: JIT approved: ESC-9921. Maya granted ff-temp-admin role for 2 hours. Audit ref: audit-26-03-22-9921

Maya: thanks! ran the repro after enabling, confirmed fix path. toggled back to original state. pasted commands below:
```
# enable
curl -X PATCH -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  https://console.redwood.ai/admin/flags/payment-retry \
  -d '{"enabled":true}'
# disable
curl -X PATCH -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  https://console.redwood.ai/admin/flags/payment-retry \
  -d '{"enabled":false}'
```

Chris: awesome, thanks for the quick turnaround. can you add a 1-2 line summary in the ticket with timestamps + audit ref? helps our postmortem log.

Maya: added summary and audit id. also flagged a small follow-up to add a staging test that mirrors the prod flag behavior.

Ellie: perfect. one more note: if you need repeated access, request a scoped readonly view or a canary rollout percent instead of full toggles.

Maya: got it, thanks everyone. excited to be here :smile:
